limits: Bounded mapping of saved installed distributions, bundled native filenames, exact-version build metadata and matched wheel SBOMs. Not a complete binary/compliance attestation.
Mapped means identified notice material, not legal certification. Fresh image file membership, hashes, modes, ownership and affected-layer qualification remain pending.
Binary lists bind containing libraries for statically linked or header-only components; they do not prove object reachability. GDAL versions are exact recipe declarations, not fresh runtime calls.
Source URLs use exact release tags/versions or commits; SHA-256 pins fetched bytes. No source code, wheel archives or private host paths are shipped.
Identical added bytes are stored once only after independently fetching component-specific sources; each component retains its own source/hash attribution.
Retained copyright files and their hashes refer to the saved image. No Docker or filesystem reread of that image occurred in this correction.
Build-only Rust SBOM scope-excluded crates, vcpkg host tools, boost-cmake/uninstall, empty Linux libiconv port, and OpenSSL build-only Perl are not asserted runtime components.
